ranked for beginner to intermediate lifters:
small jumps, a setup you can repeat, safe to train alone.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#5 push-ups
great to start. hard to add small amounts of load once they get easy.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#4 cable flyes
good stretch, but cable stacks vary between gyms, so numbers are hard to compare.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#3 incline dumbbell press
each dumbbell jump is a big step, so add reps before weight.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#2 barbell bench press
small plate jumps. use a spotter or safeties when you go heavy.

bonus tip: none of this works if you forget last session.
i'm building EARND for that.

slides.image_direction: REAL FOUNDER PHOTO: crop and resize only, face and physique unchanged
slides.text:
#1 machine chest press
same seat, same pin, small jumps. the easiest one to repeat and beat.
